evidence: Carries the Build system label and modifies CMake feature detection scripts and CI environment configurations to require GCC 13.
rationale: Bumping the minimum compiler version paves the way for standardizing on C++20 std::format and future C++23 adoption across the codebase. As noted by the author, 'This patch will only be released in version 33.x, or later, next year', making this change valuable for long-term codebase modernization but reasonably deferrable.
